Pemmin's Aura attached to Portent Tracker.
Portent Tracker does not have summoning sickness.
2930-3525-8328.notablePrerequisites: Rikala has exactly three tide counters on it.

Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Rikala triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Portent Tracker.

2317-6664-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

1339-1940-2921.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-1940-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2822-4179.easyPrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield and doesn't have summoning sickness.
Triumph of the Hordes is attached to your commander.
2822-4179.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander has power 8 or greater.
An opponent cannot block your commander.

1579-6495-6972--112.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Visionary Augmenter.
When Visionary Augmenter dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Visionary Augmenter enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1579-6495-6972--112.notes:
The chosen anthem effect must boost Visionary Augmenter's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

282-1479-3478.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Delina (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1895-4399-4770-5870.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Guide of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Repeat.
1895-4399-4770-5870.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1090-6626-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-3099-3755-5295.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

Activate Sakashima the Impostor using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Sakashima the Impostor. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

1526-4687-6287.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures.
1526-4687-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Circle of Dreams Druid.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G} and untapping it.
Repeat.

2308-4050-4871-7173.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4050-4871-7173.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Virulent Emissary triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Virulent Emissary trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7232.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two tapped lands on the battlefield.
2921-6972-7232.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ignition Team.
When Ignition Team dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

140-586-2511-5258-5618.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat from step 2

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

618-5361--112.notablePrerequisites: Auton Soldier is a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
618-5361--112.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Auton Soldier that has haste. Choose to have Auton Soldier enter as a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Put the oldest Kiki-Jiki into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat step 1 using the Auton Soldier token instead.
Activate Auton Soldier by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste that will be sacrificed at the next end step.
The Auton Soldier token enters the battlefield as a nonlegendary copy of Kiki-Jiki with an additional +1/+1 counter.
Activate the Auton Soldier token by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste, exile that token at the end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.
618-5361--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must increase Auton Soldier's toughness.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

116-2079-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1270-3228-5477-7060.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

338-3490-3641-4050.description:
Gain life.

Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

147-1269-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1269-5256.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Exhume.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2173-4336-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2647-3976-6853.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2647-3976-6853.description:
Cast Warrior's Oath by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Warrior's Oath and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Day's Undoing and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the face down creatures that have Warrior's Oath and Day's Undoing noted. The creatures trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, casting a copy of Warrior's Oath without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Resolve the second trigger, casting a copy of Day's Undoing without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Warrior's Oath trigger from causing you to lose the game.
Repeat from step 3.

1238-2351-2957-5467-6798.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Wylie Duke to become a Kraken until end of turn.
Activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat from step 2.

643-4338-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Maskwood Nexus, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

3593-3967-4359-4871.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Garna.
When Garna dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Resolve the Garna trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
3593-3967-4359-4871.notes: You can repeat this loop with any number of additional creatures. This will require the desired creatures to either be on the battlefield already, or to be in your hand with an additional {R} available for each creature. Simply play all other creatures with Sneak Attack before Garna, and then make sure to sacrifice them all for {R} before resolving Garna's trigger.

1274-1786-2541.description:
Activate Benthic Biomancer by paying {1}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.
1274-1786-2541.notes: If Benthic Biomancer has a +1/+1 counter on it, you cannot use its adapt ability, and will need another way to put a counter on it. You can start the combo at steps 3/4 to accomplish this, or use any other method. This will also remove the mana requirement.

2105-3204-4068-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
You control at least one Mountain.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
2105-3204-4068-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2510-3705-4050-5997.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-3705-4050-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1692-3662-4872.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {1}{R}{R} each extra turn
1692-3662-4872.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Izzet Chemister.
1692-3662-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Izzet Chemister.
Activate the Izzet Chemister token's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard.
On your next turn, activate the Izzet Chemister token's last ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, casting the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Resolve that spell, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

499-2440-2609.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Soldiers.
499-2440-2609.description:
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {3}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Activate Farrelite Priest by paying {1}, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1335-2445-3129-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
Devoted Druid does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1335-2445-3129-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting four +1/+1 counters on Devoted Druid.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Devoted Druid and Marath, you may use them to get infinite green mana, Elemental creature tokens, and +1/+1 counters, and/or deal infinite damage to any target(s).

2966-3253-4050-4153.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least eleven permanents.
Myojin of Blooming Dawn has at least one indestructible counter on it.
2966-3253-4050-4153.description:
Activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, causing you to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each permanent you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar eight times by sacrificing eight Spirits, adding {5}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Zopandrel by paying {G}{G} and sacrificing two Spirits, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving an indestructible counter from Zopandrel onto Myojin.
Repeat.

1263-2060-2178-4170.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Fain.
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
A creature you control has attacked this turn.
1263-2060-2178-4170.description:
Activate Fain's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
 Bloodsoaked Champion dies, triggering Fain, untapping Fain.
Resolve the Fain ability from step 1, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two counters from it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

624-3196-3518-5131.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Phantasmal Image from your graveyard by paying {U}{U}.
Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield as a copy of Muldrotha.
The original Muldrotha dies due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Last Voyage of the _____ from your graveyard by paying {3}{B}.
Last Voyage of the _____'s first ability triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Phantasmal Image dies due to the legend rule.
Repeat.
